summary: HSBC Holdings PLC filed a Form 6-K notifying the SEC of routine share acquisitions by PDMRs via automatic reinvestment of the first interim dividend for 2026. The transactions occurred on 26 June 2026 on the London Stock Exchange at GBP 14.33 per share; David Liao acquired 4,774 shares and Barry O'Byrne acquired 10 shares. This is an ordinary dividend reinvestment, not a special situation. The filing is a periodic disclosure under UK MAR, with no deal structure, board recommendation, or strategic event. No risk arbitrage angle exists.
